name: manual_05ad11
claim: Never mark an outbox record delivered without receiver evidence; retarget historical records one at a time and never in bulk.

decisions.notes: Stored destinations predate DHCP and TLS changes; a health 200 or a portal ok:true proves acceptance only, and the evidence ladder ends at a receipt reported by the receiver.

rationale: Stored destinations predate DHCP and TLS changes; a health 200 or a portal ok:true proves acceptance only, and the evidence ladder ends at a receipt reported by the receiver.
